sinopsis.es: ¿Qué aspecto tiene lo queer cuando has pasado la vida borrando sus huellas para sobrevivir? El director comparte su recorrido por la violencia silenciosa de la burocracia. El sistema de asilo belga exige a solicitantes LGBTQ+ narrar lo indecible a desconocidos: lo queer debe traducirse en pruebas y el trauma, en testimonio.
sinopsis.en: What does queerness look like when you’ve spent a lifetime erasing every trace of it to stay alive? In Red Elephant, the director shares his journey through the quiet violence of bureaucracy, where queerness must be translated into evidence, and trauma into testimony. In Belgium’s asylum system, LGBTQ+ seekers, many from worlds where silence meant survival, are asked to speak the unspeakable, recounting their most intimate wounds to strangers they’ve only just met.
